in_sanskrit.name: Rushika
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Rushika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rush' which means 'to move, to flow, or to make progress'. The suffix '-ka' could potentially mean 'little' or 'young one' in various Indian languages.
